prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic lifestyle fashion photography of a handsome young man sitting comfortably in a sophisticated modern café, inspired by the reference composition and aesthetic. A striking 25-year-old man with thick, naturally textured dark brown-black hair, slightly tousled and softly falling around his forehead, sharp masculine jawline, defined cheekbones, straight nose, expressive deep dark eyes, subtle light stubble, and naturally attractive features.

He is seated elegantly in a luxurious cognac-brown leather lounge chair, legs crossed casually, holding a matte-black ceramic coffee cup near his lips as he takes a relaxed sip. His expression is calm, confident, sophisticated, and slightly contemplative, looking naturally toward the side rather than directly at the camera.

He wears a perfectly fitted light pastel-pink vertically striped button-down shirt with the sleeves casually rolled to the forearms, paired with tailored charcoal-gray wide-leg trousers and polished dark-brown leather loafers. Add a minimalist luxury wristwatch and subtle bracelet for an understated premium look.

The setting is a stylish contemporary café with warm cream-colored paneled walls, elegant architectural details, a large curved muted-green decorative wall element, wooden tables, modern brown leather seating, and a refined terrazzo floor. Soft natural daylight enters from the side, creating gentle shadows and realistic skin tones.
